components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive waitlist action on dark surfaces.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Unirme a la lista de espera</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 0; border-radius: .75rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #109d8f, #22b8a8); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(34,184,168,.24); color: #031016; cursor: pointer; font: 600 .875rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: .75rem 1.25rem; transition: transform 240ms ease, box-shadow 240ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -24px rgba(45,212,191,.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that stays legible on the navy hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { appearance: none; background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-radius: .75rem; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font: 600 .875rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: .75rem 1.25rem; transition: transform 240ms ease, background-color 240ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Dark Field
components.description: A high-contrast waitlist field with a clear teal focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field-label { color: #dbe5f1; display: grid; font: 500 .875rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; gap: .5rem; } .ds-field { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius: .75rem; color: #f8fafc; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: .65rem .8rem; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-field:focus-visible { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); border-color: rgba(45,212,191,.7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,.22); outline: none; } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: rgba(251,113,133,.85); }

narrative.overview:
Comelu combines the measured confidence of a well-calibrated laboratory instrument with the clarity of contemporary product communication. The interface should feel clinically clean and technically fluent without turning sterile, bureaucratic, or futuristic. It earns attention through hierarchy, space, useful imagery, and crisp type—not decorative excess.

The landing is a restrained dark-to-light editorial journey: deep navy frames the promise and action, while cool paper surfaces make explanatory content calm and legible. Teal is a precise signal for action, progress, and focus, used sparingly enough to retain its authority.
keyCharacteristics: Calm technical credibility rather than generic enterprise formality.
Warm, specialized clarity rooted in dental laboratory work.
Layered but legible surfaces, with depth reserved for hierarchy and state.

rules.name: The Measured Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal carries intent. Keep it rare enough that a waitlist action, focus ring, or status cue remains instantly recognizable.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Type Rule
rules.body: Headlines state the practical value plainly. Supporting copy explains the workflow; it does not inflate it with hype or generic AI language.

rules.name: The Continuous Canvas Rule
rules.body: Prefer a small number of large visual surfaces rather than alternating dark and light backgrounds section by section. Transitions should feel editorial and continuous, not like stacked website templates.

rules.name: The Layered-Not-Glossy Rule
rules.body: One subtle atmospheric gradient or soft shadow can establish hierarchy. Do not stack effects until cards read as glass tiles.

dos: Do use dark navy to frame the brand promise and light paper to make explanatory content easy to scan.
Do use teal to identify action, focus, selection, and progress with disciplined restraint.
Do pair every interactive state with visible focus, semantic labeling, and non-color-only feedback.
Do keep animation short, subtle, and optional; preserve the content and interaction when motion is disabled for reduced-motion preferences.
Do choose imagery that feels specific to laboratory work, equipment, materials, or real operational context.
donts: Don't turn the system into generic enterprise software, hospital bureaucracy, an outdated ERP, a playful startup app, a consumer social feed, neon cyberpunk, or a speculative AI aesthetic.
Don't introduce heavy gradients, pervasive glassmorphism, low-contrast dark surfaces, rounded bubble UI, skeuomorphism, busy layouts, or stock-photo-heavy composition.
Don't use salesy, hype-driven, buzzword-heavy, overly technical, casual, humorous, or fear-based copy.
Don't rely on color, hover, animation, or fine pointer precision as the only way to understand or operate the page.
